gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Funnel Display above it draws every line like bent spaghetti, so the page moves from a loud, uniform stroke to a text face with a bit of pen-shaded guidance.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-pridi: Marker-tip lines, tall and loud. Funnel Display draws everything with one uniform stroke, and Pridi, a serif, answers with small letters that stand almost capital-sized and leave generous gaps where curves meet stems.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-scope-one: Scope One spills its counters out into the space around it, with stubby ascenders next to a big x-height. Yet Funnel Display, bent like cable with no swelling or thinning, gives the serif text something firm to sit under.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-slabo-13px: Dignified and bookish, Slabo 13px opens up its tall a, e and s with large counters under Funnel Display's tubelike lines. Clarity in the rounded letters is the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified is the word for Suwannaphum, a serif whose c bends open like a paperclip and whose x-height stands high and squared off. And Funnel Display, with no swelling where curves meet stems, gives that sturdiness a smooth, spaghetti-like headline above it.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-hepta-slab: Gabarito looks drawn with a single nib, its terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. And Hepta Slab, a classic serif, stretches each word wide with open counters; making the heading bigger than the text will let that difference show.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-kiwi-maru: One nib, open-cut ends, loads of attitude. Gabarito leads, and Kiwi Maru, a text serif with generous letterspace and terminals stopping far from the stem, may want a bit more size than you'd expect.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-epunda-slab: Wide-set and confident, Goldman rounds its forms like open parentheses and lifts its lowercase high against the capitals. Epunda Slab, a classic serif with a gaping c, sits under it with tall rounded letters.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders and descenders. And Goldman, with its wide-set letters and big lowercase, earns its place when it is big and short.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-glegoo: Goldman spaces its letters widely and rounds them like open parentheses, giving every line a bold, commanding stance. Glegoo, a classic serif with big counters and unclosed mouths, handles the quieter reading work.
